units.Jeremiah 26:24: Daughter Egypt was put to shame, handed over to a people from the north.
units.Jeremiah 26:25: I am taking vengeance for Amon her son upon Pharaoh and those who trust him.
units.Jeremiah 26:27: But do not fear, My slave Jacob, nor be terrified, Israel, for I am saving you from afar and your offspring from their captivity. Jacob will return, be quiet, and sleep, and no one will trouble him.
units.Jeremiah 26:28: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. I will make an end of every nation where I thrust you out, but I certainly will not make you perish. I will discipline you for judgment and certainly will not acquit you.

changed_cases.source_text: Prepare a portion; tune a string; prepare a portion, Amon, who dwells among rivers, water around her, whose dominion was the sea and whose walls were water,
changed_cases.reason: The read Jeremiah passage says Egypt is shamed and vengeance is taken for Amon her son upon Pharaoh and those trusting him. Nahum addresses Amon among rivers with watery defenses. The 'her son' and vengeance-for wording does not establish the identity of Nahum's addressed place, so the shared name alone is not retained as a supported pair.
